title: LibreOffice includes a dBASE database driver, which reads dBASE tables and their .ndx index files when a folder of…
description: A heap buffer overflow vulnerability exists in LibreOffice's dBASE database driver when reading .ndx index files. The flaw arises because the number of entries in an index page is not properly validated against the page's capacity, allowing crafted index files to cause buffer overflows or infinite recursion by referencing parent pages. This vulnerability can lead to denial of service or other impacts due to memory corruption.
